chunks: So that He may know if they have delivered their Lord's messages. He comprehends all that has been given them, and keeps count of everything.
ai.seo_question: What does Allah know regarding the messengers' delivery of His messages?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a divine guarantee of the prophets' trustworthiness (Amanah), confirming that they fulfilled their duty without omission or addition, thereby validating their mission. It underscores Allah's comprehensive knowledge (Ilm) and precise accounting (Hisab), assuring believers that every detail of the messengers' efforts and the recipients' responses is meticulously recorded.
